notes.title: DAIR 5.1.0
notes.notes: [p]Hey, happy 6th anniversary to NAIR! (August 1st, when this drops, surely) Here's the rundown of changes to DAIR:[/p][p][/p][h2]Controller Updates[/h2][list][*][p]Native gamecube controller support has been added![/p][list][*][p]This requires installing a driver using zadig. This is the same setup process required to make gamecube controllers work with Dolphin emulator, or Rivals of Aether 2, so if you have gamecube controller working in those games you're already set. Otherwise, here's the instructions: [url="https://dolphin-emu.org/docs/guides/how-use-official-gc-controller-adapter-wii-u/#Windows"]Dolphin Gamecube Controller Setup, Windows[/url][/p][/*][*][p]A new controller config menu has been made specifically for gamecube controllers[/p][/*][*][p]IMO this is the new best way to play the game, on controller[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added support for Nintendo Switch 2 Pro Controller[/p][/*][*][p]Joysticks' diagonals have been boosted, allowing them to hit perfect diagonal airdodges that were previously only accessible to dpads & keyboards (oops)[/p][/*][*][p]Controller config save location has been moved from the Windows registry to a normal file on your computer. Same folder as game mode save files[/p][/*][*][p]Added new sprites to the controller select screen for several new controllers[/p][list][*][p]PS5 Dualsense, Stadia controller, joycon, etc[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Cross Platform Multiplayer with the Android release of NAIR[/h2][list][*][p]The Android version of NAIR is coming soon, but this patch will allow you to play with Android users once it drops.[/p][/*][*][p]New icons have been added to multiplayer lobbies to indicate what version of the game you're playing from (Itch, Steam, Android).[/p][/*][*][p]Several features that are only accessible in the Android version, such as touch screen controls[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where spectators wouldn't see the proper colors in online matches[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue with airdodging on joysticks, mentioned earlier[/p][/*][/list][h2]Known Issues[/h2][list][*][p]The lossless gamecube adapter, or any other gamecube adapter-like device that polls at ~1000hz, may cause freezing or crashes if unplugged while the game is running. This is due to the controller polling so quickly that a packet is received after the disconnect[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]So if you boot up the game right now, you'll notice it says "5.1.0 Preview". This is simply in case anything needs to change last minute for the Android release, but for PC users this should be pretty much exactly what the final version looks like.[/p][p][/p][p]Otherwise, NAIR will be at Supernova 2025 next week! Come say hi if you're attending that event.  See you soon, Teridax[/p]

notes.notes: Fixed a bug where custom colors might not work when playing online with users in a different country.

notes.title: DAIR 4.1.0
notes.notes:
[h2]Gameplay changes to DAIR Gamemode[/h2]

[list]
[*] When touching the blastzone, in addition to losing a point, you will heal 2 hit points of health, up to a maximum of 5 hp.
[*] At high knockback (3 hp or less), buffering an airdodge out of hitstun will no longer immediately halt your momentum.
[list]
[*] You can still halt your momentum with an airdodge, but it must be input in-between hitstun ending and touching a blastzone. It still exists, but takes skill to perform.
[/list]
[*] Spikes are now stronger in the air.
[list]
[*] Knockback is calculated as if the spiked player had 2hp less health.
[/list]
[*] The back/final hitbox of DAIR has been adjusted for consistency.
[list]
[*] On the final frame of the move, the normal/body hitbox no longer extends behind the player. This makes the small hitbox on the hammer easier to connect with. Pictures of active frames 3 and 4 attached
[/list]
[/list]

My goal in this patch was to reduce survivability of attacks at high knockback, but to make comebacks more feasible. The hitbox change, additionally, should make the combo starting final hit of DAIR feel less random when it connects.

notes.title: DAIR 4.0.1
notes.notes:
The goal of this patch is to add some QOL tweaks to combos- making them slightly more reliable and rewarding.

[list]
[*] Landing during an attack no longer incurs extra landing lad if the attack connected
[*] All attacks do +1 extra frames of hitstun
[*] The airdodge invulnerability starts 1 frame later
[*] The landing/wavedash lag hurtbox is 15 pixels taller
[/list]
